jobs.occupation: Lead Engineer - Applied AI & Data Products (Leiter/in - Engineering)
jobs.description: DescriptionAre you excited about building smart, data-driven products using the latest AI technologies — and about owning the technical and customer-facing responsibility that comes with it? At SQUER, we help our customers unlock the potential of AI through real-world software solutions — not by building custom models from scratch, but by applying LLMs, cloud-native AI services, and smart engineering. Join our Product Delivery Unit and lead how applied AI enhances modern digital products.Your tasks• AI-Powered Product Architecture: Design and own the architecture of AI-enhanced software products using modern cloud services and frameworks (e.g., Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, LangChain).• Applied LLM & Expertise: Apply Large Language Models (LLMs), cognitive services, and related technologies to solve complex, high-impact customer problems independently.• Customer Consulting: Lead workshops and technical discussions with product managers, designers, and customer stakeholders, representing SQUER with confidence and identifying where AI adds measurable value.• Scalable Systems Design: Architect scalable data pipelines and APIs that power intelligent features in production-grade environments, taking full technical ownership.• Technical Leadership & Mentorship: Guide and develop engineers within your team, shape our applied AI engineering practices, and ensure project and team success.• Thought Leadership: Represent SQUER's applied AI expertise externally — through client relationships, internal knowledge-sharing, or community engagement.Your qualifications• Extensive Software Engineering Experience: Several years of hands-on and architectural experience in software engineering (e.g., Python, Java, C#, JS/TS, or similar).• Applied AI Depth: Proven, independent experience applying AI services in production (e.g., LLMs, NLP APIs, cognitive services), not just experimenting.• Cloud Platform Ownership: Confident designing and deploying AI-driven features on AWS, GCP, or Azure at production scale.• Data & API Architecture: Strong understanding of data processing, APIs, and databases (SQL & NoSQL), with the ability to make architectural decisions independently.• Leadership & Mentorship: Ability to guide, coach, and develop other engineers, and to take responsibility for a team's delivery and satisfaction.• Customer-Facing Confidence: Comfortable representing SQUER independently to customers with a high degree of professionalism.• Languages: Fluency in German and English.Your Benefits Why You'll Love Working at SQUER:• Ownership & Responsibility : at SQUER, we believe in empowering our team. In our flat hierarchies, your ideas and actions matter more than titles. Take the reins, make an impact and grow with us.• Learn & Grow : Tap into a € 5.000 annual training budget to sharpen your skills and take advantage of our in-house Leadership Academy. Join and be part of our active tech community through meetups, hackathons and training sessions. Get up to 40h/year additional time off for your personal education.• Exciting Challenges & Real Impact : Dive into diverse projects where your work truly makes a difference – for our clients and for SQUER.• Flexibility for Performance : Benefit from hybrid work options, flexible hours, workations within the EU, and additional vacation days – giving you the freedom to perform at your best.• Tailored Tools for Success : Choose your preferred hardware configuration and leverage our suite of AI tools and licenses (Anthropic, OpenAI, and more) to suit your working style.• We Value You : Beyond perks and benefits, we offer a competitive annual salary to recognize your exceptional contributions.• Be Part of a Thriving Team Culture : At SQUER, collaboration and connection are at the heart of what we do. Through open communication, shared successes, and meaningful team events – including our annual SQUER offsite – we cultivate a culture where everyone feels valued and inspired to grow together.• A Perks-Packed Workplace : Work in a central office near Ostbahnhof and enjoy meal vouchers, EGYM Wellpass membership, a free Deutschland-Ticket, JobRad, referral bonuses, Corporate Benefits, and Pluxee employee gifts for special occasions.We believe in transparent and fair compensation. For this role, the annual gross salary ranges between € 81.000 and € 103.000 – the exact placement depends on the seniority level we assess together during the process.About usWe are dedicated to creating a supportive workplace where everyone can thrive and be proud to be part of the team. We encourage our colleagues to ask questions, try new things, pursue ongoing professional development, and take calculated risks.Are you ready to learn and collaborate in independent agile teams? We are looking forward to meeting you.&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;nbsp;&amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;nbsp; frameborder="0">

Purpose of your JobOur Science and Technology team is looking for a Modelling Scientist to advance data-driven drug development through cutting-edge computational approaches.In this role, you will apply mechanistic models, machine learning, and molecular simulations to predict the stability and behaviour of biopharmaceutical products. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to integrate modelling into experimental workflows and support innovative, model-informed development strategies.Are you passionate about scientific modelling and pharmaceutical innovation?Join us and shape the future of computational drug development—apply today!Your Responsibility- Act as a scientific contributor in cross-functional research and development projects, supporting the integration of advanced modelling approaches into biopharmaceutical development.- Develop, validate, and apply advanced computational models to simulate the physical and chemicals stability, as well as the behaviour, of biopharmaceutical drug products.- Integrate experimental and structural data into predictive modelling frameworks.- Utilize a range of modelling techniques, including mechanistic models, machine learning approaches, and molecular simulations, to generate actionable scientific insights.- Contribute to the development of internal modelling platforms, tools, and workflows to enhance scalability and reproducibility.- Design and execute simulation studies to investigate formulations parameters, degradation pathways, and process related risks.- Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including formulation scientists, analytical experts, and business developers to align modelling strategies with project objectives.- Analyse and interpret complex data to generate actionable insights.- Translate and present complex modelling outcomes into clear, impactful recommendations for internal stakeholders and project teams.- Ensure model quality through rigorous validation procedures and documentation, following internal standards and regulatory expectations where applicable.- Drive continuous innovation by exploring and implementing state-of-the-art computational approaches relevant to pharmaceutical formulation science.- Maintain up-to-date knowledge of developments in computational modelling, data science, and biopharmaceutical development to ensure the scientific relevance and competitiveness of modelling approaches.- Contribute to scientific excellence by co-authoring peer-reviewed publications.- Support regulatory submissions by providing modelling data and documentation as needed.What you need to succeed- Master’s degree or higher in Chemistry, Physics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field (PhD preferred)- Formal training or academic coursework in mechanistic modelling, machine learning, bioinformatics, or molecular dynamics is advantageous.- 2–5 years of experience in pharmaceutical research and computational modelling, ideally with exposure to protein- and nucleic acid-based therapeutics.- Strong programming and data analysis skills, with proficiency in tools such as Python, MATLAB, or R, and familiarity with modelling and simulation libraries.- Expertise in mechanistic modelling, machine learning, molecular modelling, or molecular dynamics simulations.- Solid understanding of biopharmaceutical products, including structure-function relationships, degradation mechanisms, and formulation challenges.- Experience in integrating computational models into experimental workflows and interdisciplinary project settings.- Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities, with a track record of scientific contributions such as peer-reviewed publications or conference presentations.- Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex modelling results into clear insights for diverse audiences.- Fluency in English, both written and spoken.- Collaborative and team-oriented mindset with a proactive and open approach to interdisciplinary work.- A passion for scientific innovation, curiosity, and a commitment to staying at the forefront of computational and pharmaceutical science.Ergänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Grundkenntnisse: Modellbildung, Simulation (IT)Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Data Fabric, Molekularbiologie, Modellierungs- und Simulationssprache SystemC, Arzneimittelinformation, Galenik, Angewandte Informatik, KI-Detektoren, MathematikExpertenkenntnisse: Data Engineering, Quantitative Forschungsmethode, Laborarbeiten, Labortechnik, Programmiersprache R, Bioinformatik, Angewandte Mathematik, Biomathematik, Datenvisualisierung, Data Science, Machine LearningZwingend erforderlich: Forschung, Arzneimittelentwicklung, Pharmazeutische Technologie, Programmiersprache Python, Analysis

TYTAN TechnologiesThe PACE is fast. The expectations are high. The contribution matters. Working at TYTAN is more than a job, this is a mission. We thrive, think big, and hold ourselves to the highest standard. Our mission and values guide everything we do, and we're looking for people who thrive on ownership, embrace challenges, and are energized by meaningful work. If you're motivated by impact and thrive in dynamic environments, you'll fit right in.At TYTAN, we aim to set a global standard in autonomous air defense with AI-driven, cost-efficient systems that counter unmanned aerial threats at scale. We protect people. We protect critical infrastructure. We protect Europe’s sovereignty.Scaling this mission takes a People function that's just as rigorous, clear and compliant, precision isn't optional it is the standard and this extends to how we build and support our team. As People Operations Specialist, you'll be a hands-on part of that foundation, owning first-tier employee support while growing into broader People Operations responsibilities.Your roadmap to make an impact- Employee support & documentation: Be the first point of contact for employee inquiries and own HR-related documentation, including Arbeitsbescheinigungen, EZB, Zeugnisse, and other employee documents.- Benefits & HR administration: Handle employee questions around benefits and support the day-to-day administration of benefits and other HR processes.- Employment contracts: Support employment contract processes, including preparing new contracts, amendments, and related documentation.- Payroll: Support payroll-related processes and data, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and timely execution.- Keep employee data accurate and up to date: Maintain personnel master data and documentation with a high level of precision and confidentiality.- Take on different responsibilities: Get involved across HR Operations and take ownership of new topics as they arise, constantly getting involved in different areas, figuring things out, and getting things done.- Learn and grow: Build experience across the employee lifecycle and take on increasing responsibility as you develop.Job requirements- 1–2 years of experience in HR, People Operations, or a similar role.- Ownership & initiative: You take responsibility, follow things through, and proactively solve problems rather than waiting to be told what to do.- Fast learner & hands-on mindset: You pick up new topics quickly, enjoy figuring things out, and are happy to jump into different areas and take on new responsibilities.- Reliable & detail-oriented: You’re highly organized and precise, especially when working with employee data, contracts, payroll, and other sensitive information.- Strong communication skills: You’re approachable, responsive, and comfortable working in a fast paced international environment- Fluent German and strong English, both written and spoken are required.Why TYTAN?- Build technology with real operational impact: Develop autonomous defence systems designed to protect lives and strengthen Europe’s security- Shape scalable defence capabilities: Work on solutions built for mass deployment, cost efficiency, resilience, and reliable production at scale- Contribute to networked air defence: Help integrate our systems into multi-layered defence architectures alongside sensors, command systems, and effectors- Develop for real-world operations: Build capabilities together with end users and improve them continuously based on direct operational feedback- Move fast and take ownership: Work in a focused, high-performance team where decisions are made quickly and individual contributions have immediate impact- Define a new generation of defence technology: Join early and help shape the products, engineering standards, culture, and direction of a fast-growing deep-tech company- Work with an international mission-driven team: Collaborate with experienced specialists united by the goal of creating sovereign and effective security capabilities for EuropeOur Benefits- Virtual stock options: Participate in our success through Virtual stock options (VSOPs) at the company's current valuation- Monthly allowances: €106/month in flexible benefits including lunch discounts and EGYM Wellpass or shopping credit- Regular health care events: Health check-ups, skin screenings, mental health workshops, and an annual vitamin infusion on us- Referral bonus: Earn a reward when someone you refer joins the team- Regular team events: On- and off-site activities to connect and celebrate together- Corporate discounts: Exclusive employee discounts across a wide range of partner brands- Flexibility: Flexible working hours and hybrid work model, plus a modern Munich office built for focus and collaborationAbout usAt TYTAN, it is more than just a job; it is about embracing autonomy, personal growth, and purpose. Make a lasting impact in the new era of defense! Join us to create a safer world for all.WE are an equal-opportunity employer committed to fairness and inclusivity. We do not prioritize any specific religion, gender, nationality, or background. Due to security clearance requirements, affiliations with countries listed under § 13 para. 1 no. 17 SÜG may affect the application process.Please note that we currently do not offer visa sponsorship, so we’re only able to consider candidates who already have a valid work permit. All qualified applicants are hereby encouraged to apply.
